features:
Automation & Utility

* Auto Treat Patients: Automatically performs treatments on patients.
* Auto Check In: Streamlines the check-in process for incoming patients.
* Auto Deliver Coffee: Handles coffee delivery tasks automatically.
* Auto Revive: Instantly brings downed players back to life.
* Auto Extinguish Fire: Detects and puts out fires without manual input.
* Auto Close Portal: Automatically shuts active portals.
* Notify Patients: Sends automated alerts or updates to patients.

Player Modifications

* Infinite Sanity: Locks sanity levels at maximum to prevent negative status effects.
* Walkspeed: Adjusts movement speed parameters.
* Take Eye Drops: Triggers eye drop usage automatically.
* Teleport: Instantly moves the player across locations.

Visuals & World Interaction

* ESP NPCs & Anomaly: Highlights non-player characters and anomalies through walls or obstacles.
* Delete All Doors: Removes all doors from the environment for easy pathing.
